learner_operation: Identify the dependent quantity and equilibrium, distinguish it from any initial stock, translate positive growth proportional to the remaining gap into dX/dt=k(a-X), and choose the matching equation. Source structural banks require inspecting sign/population factors; source all-capacity banks instead require identifying the correct equilibrium.
